message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've asked Brad to send over the individual calendars for Elena and David. This is the only way to be absolutely sure that no time slot will work. I have to wait for his response, so I will end my session. My plan for the next session is to receive the calendars, and then meticulously go through them, comparing all four partners' schedules to find a common 30-minute slot. If, after that, there are no slots, I will have to consider reporting the task as infeasible. But for now, getting more data is the right move.
